text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ¡Aplausos, aplausos, aplausos!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Yukino Bijin was incredible. I really wasn't
expecting that from her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Well, she did win the Japanese Oaks. Anyone who can do that's got to be strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Keep it up, Yukino Bijin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I will! Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Did you see, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know! Everyone's so nice here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I guess I managed t'run well enough for them to
like me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I must've looked pretty conf'dent out there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. 'Member how y'helped me relax before the
race?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
After releas'n all that stress, I feel like I was
able to really be m'self out there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm... really proud of what I did t'day.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You know it!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino did great out there. I heard she was
supposed to be some kind of idol, but that's not
the sense I got watching her.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was working just as hard as the other
racers. Then again, that's probably what it takes
to be a racer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! I thought she was called the
Snow Angel because she was supposed to have this
otherworldly beauty or something, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to think that was a bit overblown. I
don't know if I'll be watching again...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When the Shuka Sho comes 'round, I'm gonna be the
coolest cat out there!
